sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 40 mK
features: Anti-corrosion (316L stainless steel) thermal-only network bullet camera (uncooled VOx 640x512 detector, 17 um pixel pitch)
25 mm thermal lens, F1.0, 24.55 x 19.75 field of view
Temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C; 21 rules (10 points, 10 regions, 1 line)
Dynamic fire detection, up to 10 fire points
Perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
15 adjustable palettes, adaptive AGC, DDE, 3D DNR
Built-in de-icing heater (max 22 W with heater on)
Audio in/out, 2 alarm in / 2 alarm out, analog BNC video output

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Single thermal channel.

release_notes: Anti-corrosion (316L stainless steel) thermal-only network bullet camera with a 640x512 uncooled VOx detector (17 um, NETD < 40 mK), 25 mm F1.0 lens, temperature measurement -20 to 150 C and a built-in de-icing heater. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.
